# NVM-18: NvM core (header only) - blocks with QM (one value, CRC-16) or ASIL integrity (two copies with CRC-32 and
# write counter, repair, events for the fault memory, quality for the RTE). The behaviour is nvm::Manager<Lock>
# (nvm/Nvm.h); the block table is generated by tools/rtegen. Host tests: test/test_nvm_core.py (doc/nvm.md).
# NVM-19: the application links it (ecu/application: systems/nvm/NvmRteBlocks.h, RteSystem; doc/nvm.md, section
# "Integration").
add_library(nvm INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(nvm INTERFACE include)
